41554.summary:
Tier-1 mage Soren can only fake forbidden spells, yet one desperate bluff makes a dark dragon kneel.Mistaken for the God of Magic and revealed as Kai Merlin, he enters a war of bloodlines, crowns, and
faith-where every lie may become the truth he must protect.

39859.summary: Dumped for being a poor monk, Zack hides a terrifying secret. He is actually a peerless Grandmaster and the Dragon Division boss. Playing a simple security guard, he crushes arrogant elites and wins a fiery cop's heart. When the martial world finally unites to destroy this nobody, who will be the first to beg for mercy?

43649.summary: Luna, reina del Clan de los Lobos, descubre que Sofía cambió a su hijo recién nacido para apoderarse del trono. Tras recibir una segunda oportunidad de la Diosa de la Luna, decide invertir el engaño y preparar su venganza en secreto. Veinte años después, la verdad está a punto de salir... ¿Quién es el verdadero heredero?
